description: Traffic Accident Analysis System TAAS is a data repository run by Korea Road Traffic Authority. TAAS publishes traffic-accident statistics and location data for Korean roads, including hot-spot analysis and downloadable accident tables, drawn from police records. Coverage: South Korea. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, html; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account.
